academic_question: Measure reproducible absolute UP/DOWN classification accuracy and compare it with training-only majority, fixed-UP, trend and reversal baselines.
candidate_selection: No candidate is selected. All fixed W3 families and all predeclared baselines are reported. Logistic h20 is designated before scoring only as the primary fitted row for discussion/figure layout.
data_limits: raw unadjusted prices; not total return
action-shaped discontinuity windows excluded but action history incomplete
2024-H1 official archive gap outside evaluated window
historical membership includes weak snapshot-floor spells
fees unavailable for 2022-2023; accuracy is not economics

decision_rules.grid_use: development display only; all points retained; no best point selected

execution_indexing.decision: last completed weekly session; cutoff next local calendar day T00:15 IST
execution_indexing.entry: first eligible observed session OPEN strictly after decision cutoff
execution_indexing.exit: OPEN on the h-th observed NSE session after entry; labelled extension on missing instrument bar

folds.kind: four expanding walk-forward folds using existing W3 validation tiles
folds.purge: drop training row unless label exit is at least 20 observed sessions before validation start

historical_data_disclosure: W1-W6 reports, W2 revealed holdout outcomes, and W3 validation metrics were available before this specification. Therefore no result is a fresh sealed test.

majority_train.rule: majority class from each fold's purged training rows only

samples.answered_accuracy: correct divided by answered eligible non-tie predictions
samples.coverage_reporting: ALL_ELIGIBLE labels with missing predictions counted as abstentions
samples.primary_reporting: COMMON_MODEL_SAMPLE intersection across all seven candidates
samples.unconditional_accuracy: correct predictions divided by every eligible non-tie label; abstentions are not correct

targets.h60: OMITTED_INSUFFICIENT_INDEPENDENT_SAMPLE: W3 had 24 monthly dates and about 2 non-overlapping periods

primary.return: future absolute raw-price executable OPEN-to-OPEN return
primary.tie: exactly 0; counted and excluded from binary denominator

windows.decision_cadence: last observed session of each ISO week
